name: Gina L. Chi
office: San Gabriel Unified School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: Gina Chi is the vice president of the San Gabriel Unified School District Governing Board, where she has served since 2022. She works as a treasury manager in the banking industry. She says the district's top needs are raising achievement for all students, including English learners, and providing mental health support. She says she helped pass Measure SG and is directing its funds to projects that benefit students.
